name: Fire Bolt
description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage.

name: Ray of Frost
description: A frigid beam strikes a creature. On a hit, it takes 1d8 cold damage and its speed is reduced by 2 hexes until your next turn.

name: Light
description: You touch an object, causing it to shed bright light in a 2-hex radius for 1 hour.

name: Magic Missile
description: Three darts of magical force strike targets of your choice. Each dart deals 1d4 + 1 force damage.

name: Shield
description: An invisible barrier of magical force protects you. +5 AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Mage Armor
description: You touch a willing creature and a protective magical force surrounds it. AC becomes 13 + DEX modifier.

name: Burning Hands
description: A thin sheet of flames shoots from your fingertips. Each creature in a 3-hex cone must make a DEX save or take 3d6 fire damage.

name: Sleep
description: You send creatures into a magical slumber. Roll 5d8; creatures with the fewest HP are affected first.

name: Thunderwave
description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Creatures in a 3-hex area must make a CON save or take 2d8 thunder damage and be pushed 2 hexes.

name: Misty Step
description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 5 hexes to an unoccupied space.

name: Scorching Ray
description: You create three rays of fire. Make a ranged spell attack for each. On hit, each deals 2d6 fire damage.

name: Fireball
description: A bright streak flashes to a point and then blossoms into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 3-hex radius must make a DEX save or take 8d6 fire damage.

name: Counterspell
description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. If the spell is level 3 or lower, it automatically fails.

name: Bless
description: You bless up to three creatures. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw, they add 1d4 to the roll. Requires Concentration.
